Used to go there since around 4 years and was always happy about the price and service level.
Today I went for cleaning and was told the promotion is Baht 999 for x-ray and cleaning. First of all the dentist was rushing and very rough to the point that I had to stop her after a few minutes. It wasn't my teeth that were sensitive. It was the dentist who repeatedly hurt my gums with the drill. After she slowed down there was no more pain. She was done in about 20 minutes. The bill turned out to be just below 1,500. The explanation was that the dentist added Baht 400 because I had many stains. In all the years I've been visiting dentists none ever charged me for stains. Moreover it was the fastest cleaning I ever had despite the many stains that I never saw. Additionally they had added a sterilization fee for sterilizing their tools. 😲 Well that's what dentists are supposed to do and have been doing for decades but I never was charged for it. Only missing that they charged me for cleaning the room I was being treated. So I told them that I'm done with their clinic. They'd be better off to charge transparently more for cleaning rather than adding some fancy fees that no one can control or verify.
All staff has a great services and dentist give a good recommend and explain the process well. Good location and acceptable price

Very unprofessional crew the whole process was a mess from the appointment to the cleaning. The dentist didn’t even clean the top on my teeth and just rushed it when I asked her about cleaning top she just said yea it’s ok. Then they charge you extra fees at the end that they didn’t tell you about at the appointment. It was close to where I am staying so I thought I try it out but I should’ve looked at the recent reviews it’s not worth it don’t recommend. I will coming here again for my future checkups!

Just a little more care and it would have been so much better.
